Players Committee [[Harc Seff (V)]] gameplay slip from the Set 0 master PDF, page 9. The cover states official text as of 1 August 2016. The Internet Archive capture establishes publication by 6 August 2016. [http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Source PDF]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive]. Rendered directly from the published PDF at 4 pixels per point, cropped to PDF coordinates (398, 558, 576, 641). No missing upper card face or artwork was reconstructed.
